observations.label: documentation_completeness_access_gap
observations.summary: The OIG said commissioning teams had created reasonably complete documentation for four of the five reviewed projects; it also found the documentation was not always accessible to building maintenance staff.
observations.evidence_pointer: Official OIG page, Executive Summary B. Finding.
observations.confidence_boundary: Reported aggregate audit conclusion; no per-document graph or raw project package is attached to this machine-readable extract.

observations.label: recipient_access_not_confirmed
observations.summary: Maintenance staff at all five projects told the OIG they were still waiting to receive complete commissioning documents, although PBC reported that two projects received electronic copies and three received hard copies.
observations.evidence_pointer: Official OIG page, Executive Summary B. Finding.
observations.confidence_boundary: This is the report's summarized interview result, not a complete row-level document inventory for each project.

observations.label: document_delivery_process_required
observations.summary: The OIG recommended a process to collect required commissioning documentation, provide each document to client agencies within specified time frames, and confirm that building maintenance staff can access it.
observations.evidence_pointer: Official OIG page, Executive Summary C. Recommendations.
observations.confidence_boundary: Recommendation is evidence of an oversight concern, not proof it remains unresolved today or that a specific buyer will pay SABLE.

observations.label: actual_project_level_documentation_completeness
observations.summary: The OIG named four projects with reasonably complete commissioning documentation—Daley College MTEC, Englewood STEM High School, Taft Freshman Academy, and Whitney Young Library—and identified Williams Park Fieldhouse as missing most of its commissioning documentation.
observations.evidence_pointer: Official OIG audit PDF, report page 8 (PDF index 9): Figure 2 and surrounding discussion.
observations.confidence_boundary: Only the overall completeness label is captured here. The underlying project records are not included, and individual missing-document identities are not inferred from the chart.

observations.label: actual_recipient_access_failure
observations.summary: At Daley College MTEC, PBC said the O&M manuals were provided by shared web platform, but the engineer said they could not access the platform and would have preferred hard copies. For the other three projects where PBC said documents were provided in person, staff reported they had not received them.
observations.evidence_pointer: Official OIG audit PDF, report page 9 (PDF index 10), lines discussing document access and delivery.
observations.confidence_boundary: The public report summarizes interviews; it does not provide the platform's access logs or complete delivery receipts.

observations.label: long_delayed_closeout
observations.summary: The OIG reported some buildings were open and occupied before formal closeout was completed, that closeout delays had delayed distribution of commissioning documents, and that some buildings had been operating up to three years without those documents.
observations.evidence_pointer: Official OIG audit PDF, report page 9 (PDF index 10).
observations.confidence_boundary: Historical 2018-2021 audit finding. It does not establish a present-day loss, current unresolved case, or buyer willingness to pay.

relevance_to_sable.supported_hypothesis: Document existence, package completeness, delivery/accessibility, and the recipient's ability to locate required records can be distinct states. A handover proof layer may need to verify both 'record exists' and 'the authorized recipient can access the required record.'
relevance_to_sable.not_supported: This report does not demonstrate that SABLE detects the issue, that the finding was caused by cross-system linkage, that a present-day problem exists, or that money was withheld.
relevance_to_sable.product_implication: Consider a future, separately validated handover-access closure after the pre-test readiness gate. Do not expand v1 scope without a buyer-confirmed case and appropriate permission.
relevance_to_sable.reuse_guardrail: Use the public summary and source pointer for research and product hypothesis. Do not scrape or republish the full copyrighted report or imply the five projects are SABLE customers.

product_implication: This independent audit gives a stronger public-data hypothesis than generic evidence completeness alone: required commissioning record existence, delivery confirmation, and recipient access are separate states. A source-linked closure should not equate a record being created/uploaded with the asset-owner's authorized reviewer having received and been able to access the correct record. This is a research hypothesis, not an implemented access probe or customer-validated paid need.
